course_name_original: Electromechanical Systems in Transport and Mechanical Engineering
course_name_en: Electromechanical Systems in Transport and Mechanical Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire orientation in problems of electrical drives.
Acquire orientation in control properties of electrical machines.
Acquire orientation in power semiconductor converters as supply sources for controlled drives.
Acquire orientation in cooperation of electric drives with mechanical load and with high level control systems in mechanical engineering and transport applications.

syllabus_topics: Power and energetic properties of electrical drives
The general mathematic model and dynamic properties of asynchronous machine
Frequency and voltage control of asynchronous machines
The general mathematic model and dynamic properties of permanent magnet synchronous machine
Overview of power converters, losses and cooling
Converters for drives with DC motors
Inverters for frequency controlled electrical drives, pulse width modulation
Feedback torque, speed and position control in electrical drives
Design and electromagnetic compatibility of pulse controlled drives
bibliography: Boldea, I., Nasar, S.: Electric Drives, CRC Press, Taylor & Francis Group, 2017, ISBN 978-1-4987-4820-9
Crowder, R. M.: Electric drives and electromechanical systems, Oxford : Butterworth-Heinemann, 2006, ISBN 0-7506-6740-0
